subject.title: fix(gateway): skip pending reply drain on skip-deferral restart

question: Should `--safe --skip-deferral` ever be allowed to discard pending replies to accelerate a gateway restart, or must it remain delivery-preserving after its pre-restart deferral bypass?
rationale: The current branch chooses a zero close-drain timeout, while current restart-close behavior and a related production report establish that zero can lose visible messages; selecting the intended operator guarantee is a product and reliability decision, not a mechanical refactor.

options.title: Preserve replies after bypass
options.body: Keep skip-deferral limited to the active-work admission check and use a bounded or deferred close-stage delivery path before restarting.

options.title: Document intentional loss
options.body: Explicitly define skip-deferral as a destructive emergency mode and accept that queued channel replies may be lost.

options.title: Pause this branch
options.body: Leave the current safe-restart semantics unchanged until the broader chat-turn restart delivery direction is chosen.

recommendation.title: Preserve replies after bypass
recommendation.body: Keep skip-deferral limited to the active-work admission check and use a bounded or deferred close-stage delivery path before restarting.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current restart reply-drain behavior that this PR would bypass.
